        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterFloat(model.Float));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterNullableFloat(model.NullableFloat));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterDateTime(model.DateTime));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterNullableDateTime(model.NullableDateTime));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterDouble(model.Double));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterNullableDouble(model.NullableDouble));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterChar(model.Char));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterNChar(model.NChar));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterNullableChar(model.NullableChar));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterNullableBytes(model.NullableBytes));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterBytes(model.Bytes));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterFruits(model.Fruits));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterFlags(model.Flags));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterByteEnum(model.ByteEnum));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterShortEnum(model.ShortEnum));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterIntEnum(model.IntEnum));
        cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeNpgsql.CreateParameterLongEnum(model.LongEnum));

        return await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    public static async ValueTask<int> TruncateAsync(NpgsqlConnection connection, CancellationToken ct, NpgsqlTransaction? transaction = null, int? commandTimeout = null)
    {
        if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open) await connection.OpenAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        
        await using var cmd = connection.CreateCommand(Pg_SqlTruncate, CommandType.Text, transaction, commandTimeout);
        
        return await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
}

        this NpgsqlConnection connection,
